name: Ana
introduction: Small cafés. Familiar faces. The everyday moments that make a neighbourhood feel like home.
note: A familiar café can be the beginning of a friendship. That is the feeling behind my little story.

name: Luis
introduction: Gardens, family and the things we learn when we slow down long enough to notice.
note: In this story, a garden becomes a way to remember a father—and the care he passed on.

name: Marta
introduction: Journeys, reunions and the quiet excitement of finding our way back to the people we love.
note: Sometimes a train ticket means more than a journey. It means someone is waiting for you.
